name: sh.simplepu/mcp
title: Simplepush
description: Send tasks and notifications to people's phones. Answers build a queryable knowledge base.

environmentVariables.name: SP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal API token from the API Token screen in the Simplepush app. Set this or SP_INTEGRATION_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: SP_INTEGRATION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Organization integration token from `sp integration create`. Set this or SP_API_TOKEN; unlocks member, topic and broadcast targeting and end-to-end encryption.

environmentVariables.name: SP_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Personal encryption keys exported from the app, comma-separated: a bare base64 key is the Personal Password key, `topic=key` binds a key to one topic.

environmentVariables.name: SP_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on how long send_task may block waiting for answers.
